g1|variants|free goods.summary: Free goods scenarios deliver materials to customers at zero sales price, either as commercial incentives linked to purchased volumes or as standalone sample and warranty shipments. Variants differ in whether the discount is determined automatically via free goods master records, generated as parent-child sub-item lines, applied directly as 100% price conditions, or governed by specialized sales document types.

variants.name: Exclusive Free Goods with Sub-Item Generation
variants.when_used: Customer orders a qualified quantity of a product and receives extra quantities of the same or different material free of charge as an additional delivery line.
variants.key_config: Free goods determination schema (VOFG) assigned to sales area; item category determination with usage FREE returning TANN; pricing procedure activates condition R100 on TANN with requirement 059.

variants.name: Inclusive Free Goods with Sub-Item Generation
variants.when_used: Customer orders a total quantity where a portion is paid and a portion is free, with the free portion split into a distinct sub-item line for tracking and delivery.
values: R100 on TANN, PR00 on TAN
Both lines on F2; TANN at 0.00
variants.key_config: Free goods condition record rule set to inclusive with line generation; main item quantity reduced to billable amount; item category determination for usage FREE assigns TANN.

variants.name: Inclusive Free Goods without Sub-Item Generation
variants.when_used: Customer purchases goods where a portion is free, but warehouse handling and billing require maintaining a single physical item line rather than creating sub-items.
values: Single line billed net in F2
variants.key_config: Free goods condition category configured without sub-item generation; pricing procedure includes condition type NR00 with calculation formula evaluating free goods ratio to deduct value directly on TAN.

variants.name: Free-of-Charge Sales Order
variants.when_used: Delivering free commercial product samples, promotional merchandise, or complimentary goods directly to a customer without any preceding sales order or invoice.
variants.key_config: Sales document type FD with delivery type LF and mandatory order reason; item category KLN with pricing deactivated or statistical; billing relevance set to blank or M (pro-forma).

variants.name: Subsequent Delivery Free-of-Charge
variants.when_used: Shipping replacement or remedy products free of charge following customer complaints, transit damages, or missing quantities, referencing an original billing document.
variants.key_config: Sales document type SD enforcing reference to preceding invoice or order via copy control VTAA; item category KLN with default billing block 08; outbound delivery creation via LF.

variants.name: Line-Item 100% Value Discount via Pricing
variants.when_used: Standard sales order item zeroed out using pricing condition techniques or promotional vouchers rather than free goods engine master records.
values: Billed on F2 with 0.00 net value
variants.key_config: Condition record maintenance for 100% discount condition type (e.g., R100); pricing procedure sequence placing R100 after base price; item category TAN retains standard billing relevance A.

g1|core|free goods|exclusive free goods.title: Exclusive Free Goods with Sub-Item Generation
g1|core|free goods|exclusive free goods.story: When a customer buys ten boxes of coffee, the seller gives them an extra mug or an additional box for free. In SAP S/4HANA exclusive free goods with sub-item generation, ordering a primary product triggers the automatic creation of a distinct second line item for the promotional product at no charge. The ordered item prices normally under category TAN, while the bonus sub-item generates under category TANN, discounts to zero via condition R100, and flows through delivery and billing at 0.00 currency.
g1|core|free goods|exclusive free goods.why_business_needs_it: Trade marketing and promotional agreements require automated incentives where purchasing target volumes yields bonus units without rep-driven manual discounts. Automated sub-item generation guarantees accurate ATP inventory reservation for the gift, prints transparent line items on customer delivery slips, and issues compliant zero-value billing lines for tax and audit trails.

Creates higher-level item TAN and automatically explodes dependent sub-item TANN with item usage FREE.
Picks, packs, and posts goods issue for both the main material and the free goods sub-item from inventory.
Generates commercial invoice F2 pricing the sub-item at 0.00 net value while recording tax and COGS.

g1|core|free goods|inclusive free goods.story: A customer buys ten units of a product and gets two of those ten units for free, paying for only eight. In SAP S/4HANA, the sales order splits the single order line into a paid main item (TAN) for eight pieces and a free sub-item (TANN) for two pieces, delivering all ten physically while zeroing the billing price on the sub-item via condition R100.
g1|core|free goods|inclusive free goods.why_business_needs_it: Companies run promotional campaigns that bundle complimentary units inside the ordered quantity without increasing the total shipment volume. Inclusive sub-item generation provides full inventory trackability across warehouse fulfillment and delivers transparent invoices showing list price alongside a 100% promotional discount for customer visibility.

g1|core|free goods|inclusive free goods.title: Inclusive Free Goods without Sub-Item Generation (Order-to-Cash)
g1|core|free goods|inclusive free goods.story: A customer buys ten items, and one of those ten is free as part of an inclusive promotional deal. Instead of creating an extra free line item on the order and invoice, the system keeps the order on a single line of ten units. In SAP S/4HANA, the sales order retains item category TAN, ships the full quantity of ten physically, and calculates a proportional pricing discount condition (NR00) that subtracts the value of the free unit. The customer receives a single delivery and a single invoice line billed net for nine units.
g1|core|free goods|inclusive free goods.why_business_needs_it: High-volume consumer goods and wholesale distributors require single-line invoicing to prevent billing discrepancies and invoice rejections in customer EDI systems caused by line splits. It simplifies warehouse operations by picking against one single delivery line rather than splitting deliveries across linked main and sub-items. It also preserves clear accounting visibility by posting gross revenue alongside an explicit promotional deduction to a sales discount account.

config_steps.why: Business needs a defined key structure to store promotional free product rules by customer and item. Without this table, the condition technique cannot look up promotional agreements during sales order entry.
config_steps.if_missing: Free goods condition records cannot be saved or searched, preventing promotional discounts from triggering.
actions: Enter transaction /nV/N4 in the command field and press Enter
Enter condition table number 001 in the Table field and press Enter
Inspect the Selected Fields pane on the left side of the screen
Verify technical key fields VKORG, VTWEG, KUNNR, and MATNR are present in the table definition
Click the Technical View icon (Shift+F11) to inspect field attributes and domain origins
Click the Back button (F3) to return to the initial condition table screen

fields.note: Standard customer and material condition table for free goods

config_steps.step: Define Free Goods Access Sequence NA00
config_steps.where: V/N1 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Free Goods > Condition Technique for Free Goods > Maintain Access Sequences
config_steps.values: Access sequence NA00: Step 10 -> Table 001, Exclusive indicator active
config_steps.check: Table T682I displays access sequence NA00 assigned to table 001 with search fields populated.
config_steps.why: Business needs an automated search sequence that evaluates master agreement records in priority order. If access sequence NA00 is missing, condition records cannot be resolved during order line entry.
config_steps.if_missing: The order engine will fail to search for free goods rules and will leave all quantities fully billable.
actions: Enter transaction /nV/N1 in the command field and press Enter
Locate Access Sequence NA00 and select its line
Double-click Accesses in the left Dialog Structure
Confirm Access step 10 is defined with Table 001
Select the Exclusive indicator checkbox for Access 10
Select line 10 and double-click Fields in the Dialog Structure
Verify document field assignments: KOMK-VKORG, KOMK-VTWEG, KOMK-KUNNR, and KOMP-MATNR
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and assign an open customizing transport request

fields.note: Standard access sequence for free goods determination
Target condition table referencing customer and material
Stops search immediately after first valid record match

config_steps.step: Maintain Free Goods Condition Type NA00
config_steps.where: V/N2 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Free Goods > Condition Technique for Free Goods > Maintain Condition Types
config_steps.values: Condition Type NA00: Access sequence NA00 -> Controls free goods condition technique search
config_steps.check: Execute transaction SE16 on table T685 for condition usage 'N' and application 'V' to verify NA00 definition.
config_steps.why: Business needs a condition type to represent promotional discount agreements on sales documents. Without condition type NA00, master data maintenance under transaction VBN1 is impossible.
config_steps.if_missing: Transaction VBN1 returns error 'Condition type NA00 is not defined' when attempting to maintain promotional rules.
actions: Enter transaction /nV/N2 in the command field and press Enter
Select condition type NA00 and click Details (F2)
Set Condition Type to NA00 and description to Free Goods
Set Access Sequence to NA00 in the Control data section
Verify Valid from date rule is set to current date and Valid to date rule is set to maximum validity
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm the customizing transport prompt

fields.note: Key identifier for free goods agreement condition

config_steps.step: Maintain Free Goods Determination Procedure NA0001
config_steps.where: V/N7 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Free Goods > Condition Technique for Free Goods > Maintain Free Goods Determination Procedures
config_steps.values: Procedure NA0001: Step 10 -> Condition Type NA00 -> Executes free goods logic in SD documents
config_steps.check: Table T683S contains procedure NA0001 with step 10 pointing to condition NA00 under application V and usage N.
config_steps.why: Business requires a determination schema that brings all free goods condition types together into a single evaluated procedure. If the determination procedure is missing, the sales document cannot run the condition technique.
config_steps.if_missing: Sales orders will not initiate free goods determination, resulting in full list pricing for all units.
actions: Enter transaction /nV/N7 in the command field and press Enter
Select procedure NA0001 from the list, or click New Entries (F5) if not present
Double-click Control Data in the left Dialog Structure
Click New Entries (F5) to add the procedure step
Enter Step 10, Counter 1, and Condition Type NA00
Leave Requirement blank and Manual flag unchecked
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and assign the customizing transport request

fields.note: Condition type linked to access sequence NA00

config_steps.step: Assign Free Goods Procedure NA0001 to Sales Document Type OR
config_steps.where: V/N6 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Free Goods > Control Free Goods Determination
config_steps.values: Sales Area 1010/10/00 + Order Type OR -> Free Goods Determination Procedure NA0001
config_steps.check: Review table T683V via SE16; confirm combination 1010/10/00/OR maps directly to NA0001.
config_steps.why: Business needs standard sales orders in this sales area to check for promotional free goods automatically. Without this assignment, order entry ignores free goods master agreements completely.
config_steps.if_missing: Entering order type OR triggers no free goods check, causing promotional items to be charged at full invoice price.
actions: Enter transaction /nV/N6 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries (F5)
Enter Sales Organization 1010, Distribution Channel 10, and Division 00
Enter Sales Document Type OR
Enter Free Goods Procedure NA0001 in the Free Goods Proc field
Press Enter to validate the organizational combination
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm the customizing transport request

config_steps.step: Configure Inclusive Free Goods Pricing Condition Type NR00
config_steps.where: V/06 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Pricing > Pricing Control > Define Condition Types
config_steps.values: Condition NR00: Class A, Calc type C, Category E, Plus/minus X -> Deducts inclusive free goods value from line net value
config_steps.check: Review condition definition via SE16 on table T685A for KSCHL = 'NR00'; verify KNTYP = 'E' and KZNEGC = 'X'.
config_steps.why: Business needs a pricing condition that mathematically deducts the exact value of the inclusive free unit from the main item. Without condition NR00 configured with category E, the pricing engine cannot calculate inclusive free unit deductions.
config_steps.if_missing: The system cannot post a value reduction on the single sales line, forcing billing at unadjusted gross totals.
actions: Enter transaction /nV/06 in the command field and press Enter
Position cursor on condition type NR00 and click Details (F2)
Set Condition class to A (Discount or surcharge)
Set Calculation type to C (Quantity)
Set Condition category to E (Free goods - inclusive)
Set Plus/minus indicator to X (Negative)
Set Manual entries to D (Not possible to process manually)
Select Amount/percent and Quantity conversion checkboxes
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and assign customizing transport request

fields.note: Negative value to reduce net price
Prevents manual overrides by sales representatives

config_steps.step: Insert Condition NR00 with Requirement 59 in Pricing Procedure RVAA01
config_steps.where: V/08 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Pricing > Pricing Control > Define And Assign Pricing Procedures
config_steps.values: RVAA01: Step 105, Cond NR00, From 100, Requirement 59, Account Key ERS -> Dynamic deduction for inclusive free unit
config_steps.check: Check table T683S for procedure RVAA01; confirm step 105 has KSCHL = 'NR00', KOBED = '59', and KVSL1 = 'ERS'.
config_steps.why: Business needs the pricing procedure to calculate the promotional discount only when inclusive free goods conditions are met. If requirement 59 or condition NR00 is missing, the invoice cannot deduct the value of the free item.
config_steps.if_missing: Requirement 59 will not trigger, NR00 will not appear on item conditions, and the customer will be overbilled for 10 units instead of 9.
actions: Enter transaction /nV/08 in the command field and press Enter
Select Pricing Procedure RVAA01 and double-click Control data in Dialog Structure
Click New Entries (F5) or insert a row directly after base price PR00
Enter Step 105, Counter 0, and Condition Type NR00
Enter From step 100 in the From column to reference base price PR00
Enter Requirement 59 (Free goods inclusive) in the Reqm column
Ensure the Statistical checkbox is left blank
Set Account Key to ERS (Sales deductions) in the ActKy column
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm customizing transport

fields.note: Calculates proportional discount against PR00 base value
Routine 59 suppresses NR00 unless inclusive free goods are active
Must remain unflagged to reduce the active customer invoice amount
Directs posting to sales deductions G/L account

config_steps.step: Configure Standard Item Category TAN for Inclusive Free Goods
config_steps.where: VOV7 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Define Item Categories
config_steps.values: Item category TAN: Rel. Delivery = X, Billing Rel. = A, Pricing = X -> Ships physical 10 units and bills main line net
config_steps.check: View table TVAP via SE16 for PSTYV = 'TAN'; verify FKREL = 'A', LFREL = 'X', and PRSFX = 'X'.
config_steps.why: Business requires the single main item to handle both physical shipment and commercial billing under standard controls. If item category TAN is misconfigured, deliveries cannot be issued or delivery-based billing will fail.
config_steps.if_missing: The delivery creation process fails with message 'Item category TAN is not relevant for delivery' (VL455).
actions: Enter transaction /nVOV7 in the command field and press Enter
Select item category TAN and click Details (F2)
Verify Item relevant for delivery checkbox is selected
Set Billing relevance to A (Delivery-related billing document)
Set Pricing indicator to X (Standard pricing)
Verify Business Item checkbox is selected
Verify Free Goods Delivery Control is blank (sub-item generation is not controlled at main category level)
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and assign customizing transport

fields.note: Enables creation of outbound delivery document
Delivery-related billing ensures invoice reflects delivered physical quantities
Full pricing evaluation active on main item

config_steps.step: Maintain Item Category Determination without Free Goods Sub-Items
config_steps.where: VOV4 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Assign Item Categories
config_steps.values: OR + NORM + [blank] + [blank] -> TAN (Inclusive free goods operates on single TAN line without FREE sub-item TANN)
config_steps.check: Review table T184 in SE16; ensure standard mapping OR + NORM resolves directly to default TAN.
config_steps.why: Business requires the order to retain a single item line without splitting into parent and sub-items. If sub-item determination is configured incorrectly, the system creates unnecessary extra delivery lines and invoicing items.
config_steps.if_missing: The sales order may fail item determination or generate an unintended TANN free sub-item line.
actions: Enter transaction /nVOV4 in the command field and press Enter
Click Position and enter Doc. Type OR, Item cat. group NORM
Verify the primary entry exists: DocType OR + ItmCatGrp NORM + Usage [blank] + HigherLevel [blank] -> Default TAN
Filter or inspect entries for DocType OR, ItmCatGrp NORM, and Usage FREE
Ensure no entry forces sub-item creation when using inclusive free goods category 1
Click Save (Ctrl+S) if any adjustments are made and confirm the transport request

Standard item category assigned to main line

config_steps.step: Configure Revenue Account Determination for Account Key ERS
config_steps.where: VKOA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Account Assignment/Costing > Revenue Account Determination > Assign G/L Accounts
config_steps.values: Table 003: App V, Cnd KOFI, Chrt YCOA, Sales Org 1010, ActKey ERS -> G/L Account 44000000 (Sales Deductions)
config_steps.check: Table C003 or C001 in SE16 confirms account key ERS links to G/L account 44000000 for sales org 1010.
config_steps.why: Business needs promotional discounts to post to a designated sales deduction General Ledger (G/L) account for financial transparency. Without account determination for key ERS, billing documents cannot release to Financial Accounting (FI).
config_steps.if_missing: Billing document creation succeeds but blocks accounting release with error 'G/L account not found for account key ERS' (VF051).
actions: Enter transaction /nVKOA in the command field and press Enter
Double-click Table 001 (Cust.Grp/MaterialGrp/AcctKey) or Table 003 (Acct Key)
Click New Entries (F5)
Enter Application V (Sales/Distribution) and Condition Type KOFI
Enter Chart of Accounts YCOA and Sales Organization 1010
Enter Account Key ERS
Enter General Ledger Account 44000000 in the G/L Account field
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and assign customizing transport request

fields.note: Standard S/4HANA operational chart of accounts
Sales deductions account key from condition NR00
P&L Sales Deductions / Promotional Discounts account

config_steps.step: Maintain Inclusive Free Goods Condition Record NA00
config_steps.where: VBN1 -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Master Data > Conditions > Free Goods > Create
config_steps.values: NA00: Cust 10100001 + Mat TG11 -> Min 10, From 10, Free 1, Category 1 (Inclusive), Calc Rule 1 (Proportional)
config_steps.check: In VA01, enter order type OR for customer 10100001 and material TG11 with quantity 10; item line displays TAN with condition NR00 deducting 1 unit price.
config_steps.why: Business needs a master record that grants 1 free unit for every 10 units ordered without splitting the order line. If this master record is not maintained, the sales order charges the customer full standard price for all 10 units.
config_steps.if_missing: The order engine finds no free goods agreement, skips condition NR00, and bills all 10 units at gross PR00 price.
actions: Enter transaction /nVBN1 in the command field and press Enter
Enter Free Goods Condition Type NA00 in the initial screen and press Enter
If key combination selection popup appears, select Customer/Material (Table 001) and click Enter
Enter Sales Organization 1010, Distribution Channel 10, Customer 10100001, and Material TG11
Enter Minimum Quantity 10 and From 10 in the quantity columns
Enter Are free goods 1 in the free quantity column
Set Free goods category to 1 (Inclusive free goods)
Set Calculation Rule to 1 (Proportional)
Press Enter to validate master data entries
Click Save (Ctrl+S) to create the condition record

fields.note: Minimum ordered quantity required to trigger discount
Inclusive free goods: free units included in order quantity without extra line
Proportional rule applies discount for multiples of base quantity

Outbound delivery LF is generated containing a single line item 10 for the full physical delivery quantity of 10 PC.
Picking status is set to fully picked (10 PC). Goods issue post creates material document (movement type 601), deducting 10 PC from unrestricted plant stock and debiting COGS.

run_steps.transaction: VF01 (Fiori App: Create Billing Documents - VF01)
run_steps.result: Invoice F2 is created containing exactly one invoice line item 10 billed net ($900.00) for the 10 PC delivered.

run_steps.result: Accounting document is generated: Debit Customer Accounts Receivable ($900.00 + Tax), Debit Sales Deductions via ERS ($100.00), Credit Gross Revenue ($1,000.00), Credit Tax Payable.
